notes: No breadboard is used; the circuit image shows the servo's 3-pin connector wired directly to the Uno header sockets, modelled as three jumper wires.
Signal (yellow/white servo wire) goes to digital pin 9 (attach(9) in the sketch and the circuit image).
Power (red/orange) goes to 5V and ground (black/brown) goes to the GND pin next to 5V on the POWER header; modelled as GND.1 (the specific GND socket is an assumption, any Uno GND is equivalent).
The servo's internal parts (DC motor, gearbox, potentiometer, control circuit) are inside the catalogue 'servo' part and not modelled separately.
The Uno is powered/programmed via USB from the IDE; the USB cable is not drawn in the circuit and is omitted.

Note for the user: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive MCP connectors need authorization via the claude.ai connector settings; they are unavailable until then (not needed for this task).
